title: Matching objects in SR(X) of a simplicial etale X-scheme are its matching schemes
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme with small etale site $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and let $U_\bullet\to X$ be an augmented simplicial $X$-scheme [def-weil-pbc-finite-split-hypercover] with simplicial operators $U(\varphi)$ [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object] and with every structure morphism $U_n\to X$ etale. For $n\geq0$ let $M_n(U)$ be its matching scheme: $M_0(U)=X$, and for $n\geq1$ the limit, in schemes over $X$, of the diagram formed by the terms $U_k$, $k<n$, indexed by the injective non-identity order-preserving maps $\delta:[k]\to[n]$, with the simplicial operators between them; let $\mu^U_n:U_n\to M_n(U)$ be the matching map, whose $\delta$-component is $U(\delta)$ (for $n=0$ the augmentation $U_0\to X$). Let $K$ be the simplicial object of the category $\mathrm{SR}(X)$ of semi-representable objects over $X$ [def-weil-pbc-semi-representable-object] with $K_n$ the one-member family $\{U_n\to X\}$ and $K(\varphi)=(\mathrm{id},(U(\varphi)))$. Then for every $n\geq0$: (1) $M_n(U)$ exists and $M_n(U)\to X$ is etale, so $M_n(U)$ is an object of $X_{\Et}$; (2) there is an isomorphism in $\mathrm{SR}(X)$ from the matching object $M_n(K)$ of [def-weil-pbc-semi-representable-object] to the one-member family $\{M_n(U)\to X\}$ under which the matching morphism $K_n\to M_n(K)$ corresponds to the morphism $\{U_n\}\to\{M_n(U)\}$ with component $\mu^U_n$; (3) $K_n\to M_n(K)$ is a covering in $\mathrm{SR}(X)$ if and only if $\mu^U_n$ is surjective. Consequently $K$ is a hypercover of $X$ in $\mathrm{SR}(X)$ if and only if $\mu^U_n$ is an etale covering (a surjective etale morphism) for every $n\geq0$.

proof.text: Construct a limiting proper-face cone in X.Etale in each degree. In degree zero use id_X and the empty diagram. In degree one use matching_object_one and matching_object_proper_faces_one. In degree n+2 use matching_object_succ_succ and matching_object_proper_faces_succ_succ. In every case the chosen matching map has the prescribed components.

Reuse the proved private properFace_finCategory construction from Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtaleAffineAcyclicHypercoverGeometry via import all. It supplies finiteness of the proper-face category and its homs. The inclusion X.Etale→Over X preserves finite limits, so the cone remains limiting over X. Only this helper is used from the geometry module, not its affine hypercover theorem.

proof.text: The singleton inclusion sends any limiting cone to a limiting cone. For an arbitrary cone of formal families, each component of its vertex gives a cone in the original category. Apply the original limiting lift to each component. The factorization and uniqueness equations hold componentwise. No terminal-and-pullback preservation argument is required.

The recorded SR matching objects themselves have limiting proper-face cones: in degree zero the terminal family, in degree one the recorded product, and in degree n+2 the recorded multiequalizer. Apply the proper-face comparison to their canonical matching maps. Limit uniqueness compares these cones with the singleton image of the previously constructed etale cone. Equality after every projection proves the matching-map equation.

Reuse the proved private covering_of_iso theorem from Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.HypercoverOneMoreSimplex via import all, rather than copying it or covering_of_split_epi. Covering permanence transports the matching covering through the comparison isomorphism and its inverse. For a singleton map the small etale topology criterion says exactly that its underlying scheme map is surjective. Every morphism of X.Etale is etale by cancellation. Only the covering helper is used from the one-more-simplex module, not its main theorem.
Unfold IsSemiRepresentableHypercover degree by degree, use the covering equivalence, and insert the etaleness instance for each matching map.

lean.statement: theorem sr_matching_object_one_member (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : SimplicialObject X.Etale) : ∃ (M : ℕ → X.Etale) (π : ∀ n : ℕ, (Functor.const _).obj (M n) ⟶ U.properFaceDiagram n) (μ : ∀ n : ℕ, U _⦋n⦌ ⟶ M n), M 0 = Etale.mk (𝟙 X) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, Nonempty (IsLimit ((Etale.forget X).mapCone (Cone.mk (M n) (π n))))) ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ) (a : SimplicialObject.ProperFaceCategory n), μ n ≫ (π n).app (op a) = U.map a.obj.hom.op) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ ψ : semiRepresentableMatchingObject (U ⋙ FormalCoproduct.incl.{w} X.Etale) n ≅ (FormalCoproduct.incl.{w} X.Etale).obj (M n), semiRepresentableMatchingMap (U ⋙ FormalCoproduct.incl.{w} X.Etale) n ≫ ψ.hom = (FormalCoproduct.incl.{w} X.Etale).map (μ n)) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, IsSemiRepresentableCovering (semiRepresentableMatchingMap (U ⋙ FormalCoproduct.incl.{w} X.Etale) n) ↔ Surjective (μ n).left) ∧ (IsSemiRepresentableHypercover (U ⋙ FormalCoproduct.incl.{w} X.Etale) ↔ ∀ n : ℕ, Etale (μ n).left ∧ Surjective (μ n).left)
lean.note: Uses the existing properFaceDiagram (the added, already-landed stmt_dep) and the recorded SR matching objects. SimplicialObject X.Etale encodes exactly the augmented simplicial X-scheme with every term etale; the matching cone is limiting after forgetting to Over X. No splitting, covering, finiteness or qcqs hypothesis is imposed.
